title: PM corpus audit (maintainer-directed): classify every instruction line — keep / duplicate / demote / delete — then rewrite and re-lock every ratchet
body:
Anchor card for the maintainer-directed corpus audit. Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01EXxTW8mvPBhoHxmyPZ63de`), PM loop round 5.

## Mandate (verbatim, 2026-08-31, chat)

「最近我也感觉项目经理越来越笨，是不是胡乱写的文字太多了，要不要完整的认真重新整理一下，哪些是关键条款，哪些应该删除。」 — GO given as 「做」.

Companion rulings the same hour: 「你的工作不应该是不把issue 全收，还需要重点审核skills 改进值不值」 (reject authority — the value gate) · 「13580 B(荐」 (first construct removal under this posture: duty ⑦'s reader half).

## Thesis

#12911: rule accretion degrades execution — every marginal instruction line taxes every future turn of every seat; construct removal (#11901 precedent) held where added rules kept failing. This audit executes that thesis corpus-wide instead of card-by-card.

## Scope (measured at origin/main `9c120f030`)

| file | lines |
|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 947 (→960 when PR #13505 lands) |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` (dispatch-runbook 271 · platform-readings 314 · review-checklist 84 · contract-review 48 · decision-analysis 46 · lanes/* · state-machine · compile-surfaces · the rest) | ≈1,900 |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 466 |
| `AGENTS.md` | 1,162 |
| `CLAUDE.md` | 86 |
| **total** | **≈4,500** |

## Phases

1. **Phase 1 — zero-edit classification (this seat, in progress).** Every passage classified: **KEY** (binding; changes a specific decision) / **DUPLICATE** (same rule stated elsewhere — one anchor survives) / **DEMOTABLE** (true but decision-neutral: narrative, justification, history) / **DELETE** (methodology prose, stale, superseded). Each row carries a measured justification, not taste. Posted as comments on this card, file by file. ⛔ No edits in this phase.
2. **Phase 2 — maintainer batch ruling** on the classification table (决裁批 mechanism; director seat records verbatim rulings).
3. **Phase 3 — rewrite PRs per ruling**, then every ratchet ceiling re-locked DOWN to the new counts in one pin PR (single writer on `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, after PR #13505's serial chain clears).

## Standing effects while this card is open

- **Value gate on every skills queue admission**: ① does the text change a specific decision? ② can deletion replace addition? ③ construct over prose. Already applied: #13484 and #13506 rejected not_planned; PR #13580 closed unmerged per the B ruling.
- **Prose-additive queue cards FROZEN into this audit** (pm:queue → pm:on-hold; restart = Phase-2 ruling): #13116 · #12800 · #13300 · #13432.
- **Parked escalations become audit inputs**: #13417 (PR-side PASS trace — one funded line against contract-review.md's 48/48, headroom 0) · the platform-readings ceiling escalation (branch `claude/issue-13326-platform-readings-family` @ `71b4005bb`, 359 lines vs ceiling 314; whitespace-only re-wrap measured to GROW that file, sha-proven ⇒ it is at maximal density, so Phase 3 must cut or split content there, never compress; family: #13326 #13373 #13385 #13384 #13387 #13257 #13141 #13561 #13583).
- **Ruled-but-unlanded ceiling raises HELD**: #13052-A (AGENTS.md 1162→1164) · #12980-A-FLOOR (os-dev.md 466→471) — serial behind PR #13505 regardless; the audit may render both moot. If the maintainer wants either landed before the audit, say so and it rides the chain as already ruled.
- **Corrections still flow**: text contradicting a standing ruling stays fixable now (e.g. the SKILL.md:758 pre-hang contradiction, card #13557). The freeze is for additions, not for making the corpus honest.

Refs: #12911 (thesis) · #11901 (construct-removal precedent) · #13304 (first construct removal executed) · #13484 / #13506 (first value-gate rejections).
